description: RAG happy-path: payment-method threshold for mortgaged dwelling claims. Grounded in §8.4 Claims Payment Methods of the Zava claims policy guidebook.

items.prompt: For a dwelling claim on a property with a mortgage, when is a joint check with the mortgage company required?
items.expected_response: According to the Zava claims insurance policy guidebook (section 8.4 Claims Payment Methods), a Mortgage Company Joint Check is required for dwelling claims exceeding $10,000 on properties with a mortgage. Source: 2026-03-25-zava-claims-insurance-policy-guidebook.docx (SharePoint: ZavaClaims / Shared Documents).
